decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - The basement room has substandard natural light and do not qaulify as habitable rooms.  The basement is only suitable for purposes incidental to the enjoyment Flat A, 33 St Marys Grove, Chiswick, London, W4 3LN.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 7am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and none shall take place on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Creation of basement utility room and two lightwells to rear of existing flat.
